top_signals.title: US Pushes for Russia to Resume Gas Sales to Europe, WSJ Reports
top_signals.summary: US officials are promoting a plan for Russia to resume sales of natural gas to Europe via pipelines running through Ukraine, the Wall Street Journal reported.

top_signals.title: China Should Take ‘Much Bolder Actions,’ Says Primavera’s Hu
top_signals.summary: China’s policy makers should focus on improving the country’s fundamentals instead of worrying about short term volatility and have room to take “much bolder” steps, according to Primavera Capital chief executive officer Fred Hu.
